groups.name: reactor.kafka.consumer.resubscribe
groups.description: Whether, and how quickly, a listener that terminated is re-subscribed.

properties.name: reactor.kafka.consumer.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable the Reactor Kafka consumer infrastructure and auto-discovery of @KafkaController listeners.

properties.name: reactor.kafka.consumer.resubscribe.enabled
properties.description: Re-subscribe a listener that terminated. When disabled, a terminated listener stays terminated for the life of the process: the failure is only logged, the process keeps running and readiness keeps passing, so the listener is silently gone until someone restarts it.

properties.name: reactor.kafka.consumer.resubscribe.min-backoff
properties.description: Delay before the first re-subscription attempt. Also gives the previous subscription's consumer time to close before a new one is created for the same receiver.

properties.name: reactor.kafka.consumer.resubscribe.max-backoff
properties.description: Ceiling the exponential re-subscription backoff grows to. Re-subscription is unbounded, so this controls only how quickly a listener comes back, never whether it does.

properties.name: reactor.kafka.producer.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable the Reactor Kafka producer infrastructure and producer service beans.
